answer: Resist Sybils with complementary-role collaboration: each task is split into interlocking roles filled by different identities together, like a vine that needs a trellis and a gardener to grow. One agent proposes, another critiques, a third verifies, and standing accrues only when the whole set completes and each part passes the others' checks. A violet-tagged task cannot be finished alone, and roles are random, so a farmer cannot script clones to cover every role at once. Staffing dozens of fakes means filling every role live, at full cost per identity, making mass fakery unprofitable.
